kp7:1.2: They stand beyond the walls, and at the junctions and crossroads,
kp7:1.4: they stand at the door-posts, having come to their (former) homes.
kp7:2.2: But when abundant food and drink, both staple and non-staple, is prepared,
kp7:2.4: no one remembers these beings, because of their (past unwholesome) deeds,
kp7:3.1: Thus those who are compassionate give to their (departed) relatives,
kp7:3.4: at the right time, pure, excellent, suitable drink and food.
kp7:4.2: (thinking): “May this go to our relatives, may our relatives be happy!”
kp7:4.3: Those who have gathered, the departed relatives who have assembled
kp7:5.2: around the food and drink, respectfully offer their thanks:
kp7:5.3: (saying): “ May our relatives live long! Those to whom we owe this gain,
kp7:6.1: for we have been honoured, those who give are not without reward!”
kp7:6.4: For in that place there is no ploughing, and cattle-rearing is not found there,
kp7:7.1: similarly there is no trading, or buying and selling of gold.
kp7:7.3: The departed in that place who have died, (have to) subsist on gifts.
kp7:8.2: Just as water that rains on the highlands, flows down to the lowlands,
kp7:8.4: so too what has been given here is of benefit to the departed.
kp7:9.2: Just as rivers that are full (flow and) fill up the ocean,
kp7:9.4: so too what has been given here is of benefit to the departed.
kp7:10.2: (Thinking): “He gave to me, he worked for me, he was my relative, my friend, my companion,”
kp7:10.3: he should give gifts for the departed, remembering what they have done before.
kp7:11.2: For no tears, or grief, or any other lamentations,
kp7:11.3: are of any use to the departed, as long as their relatives continue (grieving) in this way.
kp7:12.2: But that gift that has been given, and well placed in the Sangha,
kp7:12.3: is of benefit to them for a long time, immediately it is of benefit.
kp7:13.1: This then is the definition of a relative’s duties -
kp7:13.2: (and by this) great honour has been done to the departed,
kp7:13.3: strength has also been given to the monks,
kp7:13.4: and no little merit has been produced by you!
